title: LLMs Assist NLP Researchers: Critique Paper (Meta-)Reviewing
authors_zh: Jiangshu Du、Yibo Wang、Wenting Zhao、Zhongfen Deng、Shuaiqi Liu、Renze Lou、Henry Peng Zou、Pranav Narayanan Venkit、Nan Zhang、Mukund Srinath、Haoran Ranran Zhang、Vipul Gupta、Yinghui Li、Tao Li、Fei Wang、Qin Liu、Tianlin Liu、Pengzhi Gao、Congying Xia、Chen Xing、Jiayang Cheng、Zhaowei Wang、Ying Su、Raj Sanjay Shah、Ruohao Guo、Jing Gu、Haoran Li、Kangda Wei、Zihao Wang、Lu Cheng、Surangika Ranathunga、Meng Fang、Jie Fu、Fei Liu、Ruihong Huang、Eduardo Blanco、Yixin Cao、Rui Zhang、Philip S. why: ReviewCritique compares human and LLM paper reviews with expert-labeled deficient segments.

title: Problem
问题
html: LLMs are increasingly used to produce paper reviews and meta-reviews, but professional language and broad coverage do not guarantee accurate or useful criticism. Without fine-grained human data, evaluation is limited to overall preferences and cannot reveal what models omit or misunderstand. This paper studies whether LLMs can reliably review NLP papers, assess the quality of other reviews, and be evaluated through concrete deficiency types rather than a single holistic score.
LLM 已被用于生成论文评审和元评审，但“语言专业、覆盖面广”并不意味着批评准确或对作者有帮助。缺少细粒度人工数据时，研究者只能比较总体偏好，难以知道模型遗漏了什么、误解了什么。该论文研究 LLM 能否可靠评审 NLP 论文、能否判断其他评审的质量，以及应如何以具体缺陷类型评价 reviewer 与 meta-reviewer，而非只看一个整体分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper collects human- and LLM-generated reviews for 100 NLP papers, with domain experts annotating deficient review segments, explanations, and 23 fine-grained error types. The data supports both review-generation analysis and meta-reviewer detection of review defects. The authors find that LLMs can produce superficially complete reviews yet frequently misread facts, make unsupported claims, offer unactionable suggestions, or miss important issues, while LLM-based second-order critique is also unstable.
论文基于 100 篇 NLP 论文收集人工与 LLM 生成评审，由领域专家对评审片段标注缺陷及解释，并整理 23 类细粒度错误。数据同时支持两个层面：评审生成质量分析，以及 meta-reviewer 对评审缺陷的识别。作者发现，LLM 能生成表面完整的评语，却常出现事实误读、缺乏证据、建议不可执行和重要问题遗漏；LLM 对这些缺陷的二次审查同样不稳定。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample papers: One hundred NLP papers are selected with their full text and review context, covering varied topics and quality levels.
  2. Generate reviews: Real human reviews are collected, and multiple LLMs are prompted to produce corresponding paper reviews for comparison.
  3. Expert annotation: Domain-familiar researchers mark deficient review sentences or segments, explain the problem, and map it to a 23-category taxonomy.
  4. Define quality tasks: The study measures defect distributions when models act as reviewers and their ability to detect human-labeled defects as meta-reviewers.
  5. Analyze errors: Models, prompts, and review sources are compared across factual errors, reasoning weaknesses, lack of specificity, and omissions.

1. 论文采样：选择 100 篇 NLP 论文，保留正文和已有评审语境，覆盖不同主题与质量。
  2. 评审生成：收集真实人工评审，并提示多种 LLM 生成对应 paper review，形成可比较集合。
  3. 专家标注：熟悉领域的研究者逐句或逐段指出评审缺陷，写明原因并映射到 23 类 taxonomy。
  4. 质量任务：评价模型作为 reviewer 时的缺陷分布，以及作为 meta-reviewer 时能否识别这些人工标签。
  5. 误差分析：比较不同模型、提示和评审来源，区分事实错误、逻辑不足、缺乏具体性与遗漏等问题。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Expert annotations show that defects in LLM reviews go beyond style and include misinterpretation of paper content, unsupported criticism, and recommendations disconnected from identified problems. When asked to critique another review, models still fail to cover many expert-identified issues and may introduce new unsupported objections. The 100 papers and 23-category taxonomy provide more diagnostic evidence than simple preference studies, although annotation cost limits scale and different fields may weight review defects differently.
专家标注显示，LLM 评审的缺陷并非只来自文风，而涉及论文内容误判、批评缺乏依据和建议与问题不匹配。即使模型被要求 critique 另一份评审，也难以稳定覆盖专家发现的全部问题，并可能新增无根据批评。100 篇论文和 23 类标签使结论比简单偏好实验更可诊断，但标注成本限制了规模，且不同研究领域对“重要缺陷”的权重可能不同。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior AI-reviewer studies often evaluate acceptance prediction, coverage, or which review humans prefer, without establishing whether criticism is correct. This work moves to review critique: experts identify problems within reviews, and models are tested as meta-reviewers in addition to review generators. Its novelty lies in a fine-grained defect taxonomy, segment-level annotations, and dual reviewer/meta-reviewer evaluation tailored to scientific reviewing rather than applying generic text-quality metrics.

已有 AI reviewer 工作常用接受预测、覆盖率或“人更喜欢哪份评审”作为评价，无法解释评审是否准确。该工作把研究对象推进到 review critique：不仅生成评审，还由专家标出评审自身的问题，再检验模型能否做元评审。新意在于面向科研评审的细粒度 defect taxonomy、片段级标注和 reviewer/meta-reviewer 双层评价，而不是把一般文本质量指标直接用于学术审稿。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Domain scope: The sample focuses on NLP, and its experimental norms or contribution criteria may not transfer to theory, medicine, or systems papers.
  2. Expert subjectivity: Legitimate disagreement exists in peer review, so some labeled defects may reflect differing scholarly standards rather than objective errors.
  3. Scale limitation: One hundred papers support deep auditing but do not cover the full distribution of venues, years, topics, and writing styles.

1. 领域范围：样本集中于 NLP，实验规范和贡献判断未必适用于理论、医学或系统论文。
  2. 专家主观性：评审本身存在合理分歧，某条“缺陷”可能反映不同学术标准而非客观错误。
  3. 规模限制：100 篇论文适合深入审计，但不足以覆盖会议年份、主题和写作风格的完整分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The data can train review critics, meta-review judges, or reviewing assistants using defect types rather than a holistic good-or-bad label. Suitable objectives include segment-level error detection, evidence citation, recommendation actionability, and omission identification. Deployment should position the model as an assistive checker whose outputs link back to paper evidence and remain subject to expert decisions; direct automated paper scoring risks amplifying reviewer biases.
该数据可用于训练 review critic、元评审 judge 或审稿辅助系统，并以缺陷类型而非总体“好坏”提供监督。适合的训练目标包括片段级错误检测、证据引用、建议可执行性和遗漏识别。部署时应把模型定位为辅助检查器，输出需链接到论文原文并保留专家最终决定；若直接自动评分论文，容易把 reviewer 偏差进一步放大。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: A dataset using expert defect annotations to evaluate LLM reviewers and meta-reviewers.
  2. Method takeaway: It combines 100 NLP papers, human and model reviews, segment labels, and 23 error categories.
  3. Data takeaway: Records include papers, review text, problematic spans, defect types, and expert explanations.
  4. Evidence anchor: LLM reviews often appear professional while containing unreliable factual claims or recommendations, and second-order critique is also unstable.
  5. Reuse decision: It is useful for review assistance and critique training but should not replace domain experts.

1. 一句话定位：用专家缺陷标注评估 LLM reviewer 与 meta-reviewer 的数据工作。
  2. 方法抓手：100 篇 NLP 论文、人工与模型评审、片段级标注和 23 类错误。
  3. 数据抓手：论文、评审文本、问题片段、缺陷类别及专家解释。
  4. 证据锚点：LLM 评审常“看起来专业但事实或建议不可靠”，二次 critique 也不稳定。
  5. 复用决定：适合审稿辅助与 critique 训练，不应直接取代领域专家判断。
